text.card: A red giant 3,181 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 6, give 0.91 solar masses and 10.5 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 5,080 K at its surface.
